answer.reason: The verses tell of events that happened to the land of Ammon: it was given to Lot's children, was struck by Jephthah, and lost its royal city Rabbah.

clauses.english: was given by the LORD to the children of Lot, so Israel did not take it
clauses.quote: I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession

clauses.english: was struck by Jephthah with a very great slaughter
clauses.quote: he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith

clauses.english: lost its royal city Rabbah to Joab and David
clauses.quote: Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

doubts: Most marked verses concern the Ammonite people or kings rather than the land, so only events that touch the land and its royal city are used.
Prophecies of Rabbah's ruin and desolation (JER 49, EZK 25, ZEP 2, AMO 1) are left out because they are not events.
